title: aibox-registry index
description: Application index (source for the aibox.im /apps directory). Spec: see docs.

registryVersion.description: Date-based registry version, bumped on every merged change.

id.description: Must equal the directory name under apps/.

category.description: Taxonomy sized for 50-100 apps. agent — autonomous AI assistants/agents that run tasks for you; chat — desktop chat clients that converse with one or more LLMs; local-llm — local model runtimes and inference servers; coding — coding assistants and code-generation tools; devtool — developer tooling and build/infra utilities; knowledge — knowledge-base and RAG tools; media — image, audio and video creation; automation — workflow and task automation; productivity — office and personal-productivity suites; utility — general-purpose system and everyday utilities; other — fallback when nothing else fits.
